usage.main:
workwood — git-worktree orchestration for multi-repo super-features

Usage:
  workwood                                 launch the interactive super-feature editor (TUI)
  workwood init [path]                     scaffold/sync this super-repo (idempotent)
  workwood project [info|rename <name>]    show or rename the current project (local label)
  workwood repos  [pull|list]              manage base reference clones in main_dir
  workwood super-feature <subcommand>      manage a super-feature (alias: sf; see: workwood sf help)
  workwood action <name> <feature> [--targets <preset>]  run an action against the feature's selected targets
  workwood actions                         list available actions
  workwood targets [list|show <feature>]   list saved target presets / show a feature's targets
  workwood lang [en|ja]                    show or set the UI language
  workwood version                         print the build + file-schema version

Global:
  -p, --project <path>                     act on the super-repo at <path> (else: walk up from cwd)
usage.feature:
Usage: workwood super-feature <command> [args]   (alias: sf)

Commands:
  create <name> [description]                     create a super-feature manifest
  rename <slug> <new-name>                        set this developer's local display name (slug stays fixed)
  add    <name> <repo> <worktree-branch-name> [--from <source>] [--no-feature-prefix] [--existing]
                                                  create a new branch/worktree; --existing attaches the exact branch name
  up     <name>                                   review folder names, then rebuild recorded worktrees
  remove <name> <repo> [sub-branch] [--prune-branch]
                                                  remove ONE worktree (+ optionally its branch)
  down   <name>                                   remove recorded worktrees, keep the manifest
  status <name>                                   branch + dirty state per worktree
  list                                            list all super-features
  delete <name> [--prune-branches]                remove worktrees + manifest (+ branches)
  relink [feature]                                validate a feature folder's back-link, regenerate if missing/stale
